In my use case, I am driving the Lean elaborator programmatically, traversing through individual compilation units. To do this, I repeatedly invoke elabCommandTopLevel. This was inspired by lean-training-data.

During the elaboration of a command that has ring_nf, the process crashed with error

libc++api: terminating due to uncaught exception of type lean::exception: cannot evaluate `[init]` declaration `Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.normNumExt` in the same module

How can I resolve this problem? My Lean version is 4.29.1

Since I'm running frontend functions, Elab.processHeader already sets loadExts := true, so it should load all the environment extensions?

The extension in question exists in mathlib4/Mathlib/Tactic/NormNum/Core.lean.

Yiming Fu said:

Maybe enableInitializersExecution is missing? See Lean.importModules.

I called this function before Elab.processHeader

Yiming Fu said:

Maybe enableInitializersExecution needs to be called before each Elab.processHeader?

There is only a single call to Elab.processHeader

Yiming Fu said:

Maybe enableInitializersExecution needs to be called before each Elab.processHeader?

There is only a single call to Elab.processHeader

Yiming Fu said:

Maybe enableInitializersExecution needs to be called before each Elab.processHeader?

There is only a single call to Elab.processHeader
Anyways I found the solution. I was calling into Lake's API, and during one of the API calls, initializer execution was turned off.
